title: Provider failure classification: origin/main vs IMP-0016 on a 26-case labeled corpus
summary: adapters.base.classify_failure scored per case against tests/fixtures/provider-failure-corpus.json (development split, author-labeled from documented provider error shapes; the same author wrote the candidate regex, so this is not a holdout result). Incumbent 14/26 (0.538): 0/12 transient-failure cases correct, 3 misclassified as quota (each opening a 60-minute machine-wide cooldown, 180 min total) and 9 as process_error (invisible to the provider breaker). Candidate 26/26 with 0 false quota cooldown minutes; quota 7/7, invalid_model 2/2 and process_error 5/5 unchanged. Full suite: 795 tests, the same 9 failures + 2 errors as the pre-change baseline (785 tests; environment-only: project registration, installed adapter copies, RTEC applicant data, Claude surface), no new failures.

limitations: author-labeled development corpus; overfitting to its phrasing is possible
a Claude is_error result whose prose mentions 'overloaded' still classifies as a provider failure (now unavailable, which costs less than quota)

provenance.source: deterministic scorer (loads classify_failure from a git ref and replays the corpus); unittest discover
